dateAssessment: Early November is spoken (later loosely “mid November”); exact dates and year come only from YAML, whose November 8–9 span conflicts with two narrated overnights; conditional on November 8, the rescue dawn is November 10, and the final return has no measured duration.

watches.summary: Late-morning reunion at Ryu’s tower; mapped approximately to the midday watch.
Early next-morning departure plus five–six hours sailing reaches roughly midday.
Three hours of talk and travel after landing; Itzal’s short wait is included.
Blu returns with the sun sinking; the next time check confirms sunset.
Overnight lodging ends with waking at the break of dawn.
Dawn departure plus two hours paddling and roughly one spell-hour; final approach is nested.
